data.exact_reserve_text: Net prior year reserves on US casualty business were strengthened during 2023, a common trend seen across the market.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Inwards RITC transferred liabilities for the 2017, 2018 & 2019 years of account, with a premium of GBP 75,243k (fair value of liabilities transferred).

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 55.574m (per balance sheet). During 2023 the Syndicate reports that net prior year reserves on US casualty business were strengthened and that a line-by-line review led to an explicit uplift to claims reserves of GBP 2.2m to allow for inflation. No explicit gross prior-year development figure (total gross movement on prior years only) is disclosed in the accounts, although gross claims outstanding increased to GBP 111.510m at 31 December 2023 (reflecting movements across years and foreign exchange). The Syndicate also executed an inwards RITC in 2022 which materially increased earlier year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: Net prior year reserves on US casualty business were strengthened during 2023, a common trend seen across the market.
A detailed review by line of business has been performed, resulting in an explicit uplift to claims reserves of GBP 2.2m.
Syndicate has seen some direct evidence of claims inflation
the Syndicate has included an explicit uplift for inflation
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior year column). No explicit gross prior-year-only movement figure (movement in provision for prior years) is provided in the notes; only narrative references to strengthening and an explicit GBP 2.2m uplift for inflation (not broken down by gross prior years). An inwards RITC executed in 2022 (Syndicate 2689) materially affected earlier year reserves (GBP 75.243m) and may distort direct triangle-based PYD calculations. The claims development table in the report was parsed but formatting is unclear; it has been included as printed but may reflect a mixture of years and RITC effects.
